prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.2% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, as neither resulted in a statistically significant win.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow) and path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic across tests, such as predicting +20.0% for sign-in reordering.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Welcome Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen layout to a structured card layout to clearly introduce the pet companion universe before path selection. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with high mean duration (514s), indicating user confusion at the very start of onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Selection Preview Flow: Add an interactive photo preview component flow within the photo upload screen allowing real-time preview of pet rendering before submitting. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, while adoption drop-off is 39.1%.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Setup Preparation Waiting Screen: Insert a desktop display environment check screen before waiting to ensure system layer compatibility before companion creation finishes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open, while home waiting has an 18.7% drop-off.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Flexible Choice Copy: Reassure users on the choose_path screen that their selected path can be changed at any time later in settings. (why: Mean duration of 514s on choose_path indicates user hesitation over picking a permanent path.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint: Provide clear photo quality guidelines directly under the photo picker to prevent failed custom pet generations. (why: Support receives emails about custom pet generation failures and rendering glitches, contributing to 39.1% adoption drop-off.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Remaining Wait Info: Display a live time estimate and processing progress details on the waiting screen so users know their pet is generating. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing significant drop-off before reaching the final screen.)
6: [finish, layout] Compact Quick Controls Home Intro Layout: Change home_intro layout to compact style featuring instant hotkey reference for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: 3 support emails noted confusion over controlling or hiding the pet after onboarding, and 35.2% drop occurs at finish.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: Home step wait time is high (mean 2336s); notifying users when ready prevents lost users who switch away.)

scores.note: Target step has 23.8% drop-off and high duration; redesigns show modest positive historical trend (+2.0%).
High drop-off (39.1%) supported by ticket reports; building a new flow requires high effort with unproven impact.
Home step has lower drop-off (18.7%); adding new screens historically degraded performance (-2.3%).

Addresses extreme wait times (2336s mean) on home step via clear progress feedback.
Targets large finish drop-off (35.2%) and explicit support tickets regarding post-onboarding controls.
